issues.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator can rupture (do-not-drive recall)
issues.sym: Nothing you can see or feel. The danger appears only when the airbag goes off.
issues.why: The passenger airbag inflator can break apart when it deploys and throw metal pieces into the cabin. Ford told owners of some of these cars not to drive them until repaired.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 16V-384, 17V-024, 18V-046 and 19V-001 right away. If one is open, do not drive the car; the dealer can arrange towing.

issues.t: Driver airbag inflator can explode (recall)
issues.sym: No warning in normal driving.
issues.why: The driver airbag inflator can explode in a crash and send metal fragments toward the people inside.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 21V-158 and get the inflator replaced as soon as possible.

issues.t: Coolant leaking into the cylinders
issues.sym: The coolant level keeps dropping with no outside leak, white exhaust smoke, rough running, a check engine light, and in the end overheating.
issues.why: On the 2.0L EcoBoost, coolant can seep into the cylinders. Ford bulletins tell dealers to replace the long block (the core of the engine) when this is confirmed.
issues.next: Check the coolant level often. If it keeps dropping or you see white smoke, stop driving before it overheats and ask a Lincoln dealer about the bulletins and any coverage.

issues.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
issues.sym: Coolant loss with no clear leak, a sweet smell, milky oil, a puddle under the passenger side, or overheating.
issues.why: On the 3.5L and 3.7L V6, the water pump sits inside the engine and is driven by the timing chain. When its seal fails, coolant can leak into the oil and damage the bearings.
issues.next: Check the coolant level and oil condition regularly. If coolant is disappearing, stop driving and get it diagnosed, because coolant in the oil can ruin the engine.

issues.t: Harsh or delayed automatic shifts
issues.sym: Hard shifts, a slow or jerky shift into gear, slipping, or a check engine light with transmission codes.
issues.why: Worn internal parts, a faulty solenoid body, or old fluid in the 6-speed automatic. Software updates help some cars.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the fluid checked. Ask about software updates before agreeing to a rebuild.

issues.t: ABS valves can stick and lengthen stops (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal goes farther down than normal, especially after the ABS has worked, and the car takes longer to stop.
issues.why: Valves in the ABS unit can react with certain brake fluid additives and not close fully after an ABS stop.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 19V-904 and have the update and brake fluid service done.

issues.t: Driver floor mat can hold the gas pedal down (recall)
issues.sym: The engine keeps racing after you lift off the gas, or the pedal does not come back up.
issues.why: An unsecured or wrong floor mat can slide forward and trap the accelerator pedal.
issues.next: Remove any extra or loose mat now. Check the VIN for recall 14E-028.

issues.t: Key gets stuck in the ignition
issues.sym: The key will not turn, or will not come out of the ignition after the car is shut off.
issues.why: Wear in the ignition lock cylinder, or the shifter not fully in Park.
issues.next: Make sure the shifter is fully in Park first. If the key still sticks, have the lock cylinder replaced.

issues.t: Chrome peeling off the wheels
issues.sym: The chrome finish on the factory wheels bubbles, flakes or peels.
issues.why: The chrome-clad wheel finish breaks down with road salt and brake dust.
issues.next: Cosmetic, but peeling chrome can cause slow tire leaks at the rim. Refinishing or replacing the wheel is the fix.

issues.t: Dashboard bubbling near the vents
issues.sym: The dashboard surface lifts or bubbles near the defroster or air vents.
issues.why: The dashboard skin separates from the padding underneath, mainly from heat and sun.
issues.next: Cosmetic. A dash cover hides it; replacing the dashboard top is a big job.

issues.t: Brake lights or tail lights stop working
issues.sym: Other drivers tell you the brake lights or tail lights are out, or a bulb warning appears, even after new bulbs.
issues.why: Problems with the LED tail lamp assemblies or their connections.
issues.next: Check the lights with a helper. Since bulbs often are not the cause, have the lamp assembly and wiring tested.

issues.t: Sudden loss of power steering assist (recall)
issues.sym: A steering warning message and the steering suddenly becoming very heavy.
issues.why: A sensor fault can make the electric power steering shut itself off.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. Check the VIN for recall 15V-340. Steering still works without assist, but it takes much more effort; slow down and pull over safely.

issues.t: Steering motor bolts can corrode and cut assist (recalls)
issues.sym: A clunk from the steering, a warning message, and heavy steering.
issues.why: The bolts holding the electric steering motor to the gear can corrode and break, letting the motor come loose.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 15V-250 and 19V-632 and have the bolts replaced.

issues.t: Doors may not latch or may open while driving (recalls)
issues.sym: A door that will not stay shut, a door-ajar warning that stays on, or a door that looks closed but is not.
issues.why: A part inside the door latch can break.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 15V-246, 17V-210, 20V-177, 20V-331 and 23V-775, even if an earlier latch repair was done.

issues.t: Steering wheel bolt can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: The steering wheel feels loose, clicks, or moves slightly on the column.
issues.why: The bolt holding the steering wheel may not be tight enough and can work loose.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 18V-167. If the wheel feels loose, do not drive until it is fixed.

issues.t: Front brake hose can rupture (recall)
issues.sym: A soft or sinking brake pedal, a brake warning, or fluid near a front wheel.
issues.why: The front brake hoses can crack and leak brake fluid.
issues.next: If the brake pedal sinks, feels soft or goes closer to the floor, or a red brake warning comes on, slow down gently, use a lower gear, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on: call for a tow. Check the VIN for recall 23V-162. Do not drive with a soft pedal.

issues.t: Front seat belt anchor cable can fail in a crash (recalls)
issues.sym: No symptom in normal driving.
issues.why: Heat from the seat belt pretensioner firing in a crash can weaken the anchor cable so it does not hold.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 16V-875 and 19V-590.

issues.t: Airbag control module can short out (recall)
issues.sym: An airbag warning light, or no symptom at all.
issues.why: The coating on the restraint control module can crack, allowing a short that may disable airbags and pretensioners.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 14V-597.

issues.t: Front seatback can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: The seatback feels loose or leans back while driving.
issues.why: Welds in the seatback frame may be weak.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 14V-164.

issues.t: Fuel delivery module can crack and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell, especially after filling the tank.
issues.why: The fuel delivery module on top of the fuel tank can crack and leak fuel.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 13V-227. Do not drive with a strong fuel smell.

issues.t: Hybrid can shift out of Park without the brake (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter can be moved out of Park without pressing the brake pedal.
issues.why: A fault in the transmission range sensor lets the hybrid leave Park without the brake applied, so the car could roll.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 13V-594. Always press the brake and set the parking brake until it is repaired.

issues.t: Brake pedal stop pad can fall off (recall)
issues.sym: Brake lights stay on all the time, or the car can be shifted out of Park without pressing the brake.
issues.why: A rubber bumper on the brake pedal can corrode and fall off, so the brake light switch reads the pedal as pressed.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 22V-011.

issues.t: Fuel tank can crack in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom in normal driving.
issues.why: Some fuel tanks had walls that were too thin and could crack in a crash, leaking fuel.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 15V-618.

issues.t: Torque converter can separate, loss of drive (recalls)
issues.sym: A sudden loss of power to the wheels while driving, or the car not moving in gear.
issues.why: Weld studs on the torque converter may be poorly welded and can break off.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 17V-427 and 18V-390. Use the parking brake when parked until repaired.

issues.t: Paint bubbling on aluminum hood and panels
issues.sym: Bubbles, blisters or peeling paint, usually along the front edge of the hood or the edges of other panels.
issues.why: Corrosion starts under the paint on aluminum body panels and pushes the paint up.
issues.next: Ask a Lincoln dealer about Ford bulletin 20-2233. Repair before the corrosion spreads.

issues.t: Tires wear out early
issues.sym: Tires wear quickly, often on the inside edges, with road noise building up.
issues.why: Alignment that is off from the factory or after pothole hits wears the tires unevenly.
issues.next: Have a four-wheel alignment checked and rotate the tires on schedule.

issues.t: Engine stalls while driving
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving or at a stop, sometimes restarting right away.
issues.why: Owners report stalling on 2013 cars; causes include fuel delivery faults, throttle problems and software issues.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Have any stored codes read right away; a stall at speed is a crash risk. Check also for open recalls such as the 2013 fuel module recall.

issues.t: Rattle from a cracked flexplate
issues.sym: A rattle or knock from where the engine meets the transmission, mostly at idle or low speed.
issues.why: The flexplate that connects the engine to the transmission can crack on 2.0L EcoBoost cars.
issues.next: Have the noise checked soon. Ask a Lincoln dealer about Ford bulletins 21-2347 and 22N12.

issues.t: Cooling fans stop from blown fuses
issues.sym: The temperature gauge climbs in traffic, the A/C turns weak at idle, or an overheating warning appears.
issues.why: Fuses for the radiator cooling fans can blow, so the fans stop working.
issues.next: Pull over if the engine overheats. Ask a dealer about Ford message SSM 48659 when having the fuses and fan checked.

issues.t: Hybrid transmission thumping or grinding
issues.sym: A thump, clunk or grinding from the hybrid transmission, usually when speeding up or slowing down.
issues.why: Contamination or wear inside the hybrid transmission. Ford bulletins tell dealers how to clean and repair it.
issues.next: Ask a Lincoln dealer about bulletin 22-2396 and message SSM 50744. Hybrid parts may still have extended warranty coverage.

issues.t: SYNC 3 screen freezes or lags
issues.sym: The touchscreen freezes, lags, reboots, or phone and navigation features stop working.
issues.why: Software problems in the SYNC 3 system, addressed by several Ford service messages and updates.
issues.next: Install the latest SYNC software. A dealer can do a master reset before replacing any module.

issues.t: Backup camera blank or stays on (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera image does not appear when backing up, or stays on the screen after shifting out of Reverse.
issues.why: A software error in the camera system.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 25V-442 and look around the car when backing up until it is fixed.
